text:
Priya R: Hey team — customer 'FjordPay' reporting sudden increase in 429s this morning. They claim their app didn't change but we see RPM spikes from a handful of IPs. Full stack trace from the client attached in the ticket.
Tom B: Thanks. Do we have their tenant id and the exact timestamps? Need to correlate with ratecap logs. Can you paste the root request_id(s)?
Priya R: Tenant t_fjord_84, sample req ids: req_01G7X0AB9, req_01G7X0ABF. Window ~2026-03-16T09:12:30Z to 09:18:00Z. They reported ~480 RPM sustained for 5 mins, their quota is 200 RPM.
Ivy L: They mentioned they recently rolled a new CDN config for polling/long-polling. Could be connection multiplexing mismatch causing duplicate requests. Also asking if we saw any per-route throttling in the console.
Eng Oncall: I'm tailing the ratecap service now. Quick check: running `rg "t_fjord_84" /var/log/ratecap/*.log | tail -n 200` shows repeated bucket drops at 2026-03-16T09:13:xx with reason=rate_limit_exceeded, bucket=tenant_rpm
Tom B: Can you grab the raw token headers for one of the failed requests? Look for `x-rate-limit-window`, `x-rate-limit-remaining`, `x-request-id` in the gateway logs.
Priya R: Pasted one failed request header dump: ```
:authority: api.redwood.example
x-api-key: fjord-***
x-request-id: req_01G7X0AB9
x-rate-limit-window: 60
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 2026-03-16T09:14:00Z
User-Agent: fjord/2.3.1 poller
```
Ivy L: x-rate-limit-remaining==0 — client is hitting a per-minute bucket. But the pattern looks like short bursts aligned to cron: every 10s they spawn 6 workers. If each worker polls concurrently that's 6x amplification.
Tom B: Agreed. Two mitigation actions: 1) Suggest client-side change: switch to a jittered backoff + central coordinator to avoid synchronised workers; 2) Server-side: we can provision a temporary burst allowance (soft quota bump) or enable a short grace window for this tenant while they roll out a fix.
Priya R: Customer requests quick mitigation — prefers server-side option while they patch. Can we do a temporary quota increase or smoothing at the proxy? Service owner?
Eng Oncall: I can apply a temporary 3x RPM bump for t_fjord_84 for the next 30min. Will instrument with metrics and rollback at 09:50Z. Command I'm going to run: ``rctl tenant update --id t_fjord_84 --rpm 600 --expires 2026-03-16T09:50:00Z``
Tom B: Also enable per-tenant burst smoothing on the edge to convert minute-burst into a token-leaky release: `edgectl smoothing enable --tenant t_fjord_84 --window 60 --burst 2.0` — that reduces instantaneous drops without long-term cost change. Ops, please confirm before applying.
Eng Oncall: Applying the RPM bump now. Pushing edge smoothing next if customer agrees.
Priya R: Customer approved smoothing and temporary bump. They will deploy a client change with randomized poll offsets in the next deployment window (ETA 2 hours).
Support Bot: ACTION_LOG: quota_bump applied by Eng Oncall (operator=oncall@redwood, id=t_fjord_84, old_rpm=200, new_rpm=600, expires=2026-03-16T09:50:00Z)
Ivy L: After bump we should monitor: 1) token usage curve (per-second), 2) latency/queue length on inference endpoints, 3) any downstream DB connection pressure. If those look stable, schedule a follow-up with customer to fully roll out client fix.
Tom B: Follow-up items: gather request rate heatmap, check for duplicate request signatures (same payload + close timestamps), verify no retry storm from SDKs (older SDKs did aggressive retry on 429). Anyone want to own the postmortem with remediation steps?
Priya R: I'll own the customer comms and coordinate postmortem doc. Will include suggested client-side code snippet for jittered backoff:
```
// JS pseudocode
async function poll() {
  while(true){
    await sleep(base + Math.random()*jitter);
    try { await fetch('/poll'); } catch(e) { await sleep(expBackoff()); }
  }
}
```
Eng Oncall: Bump + smoothing applied, initial metrics look good — 429 rate dropped by 95% within 30s. Closing temporary escalation. I'll open an infra PR to make tenant smoothing toggle faster via console.
Ivy L: Thanks everyone. Priya — can you attach the customer's deploy timeline and confirm SDK version? We'll add SDK version gating to docs if older clients are the root cause.
Priya R: Will do. Closing thread once postmortem and customer confirmation are complete. :thumbsup:
